answers.core: This feature is about improving the usability and accessibility of the built-in script editor, thus it should be core.
answers.workaround: This would be a core feature of the Godot engine and, as far as I'm aware, cannot be worked arround. Besides, it most likely would be used on a regular basis by the majority of users who use the built-in script editor.

title: Add the ability to drag and drop text in the script editor with the mouse
